finalText:
Build clean, exit 0. Two real bugs from bundle shape change, both bump-caused:

- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries` (old shape), new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict check threw on `undefined` flag; new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled (`false`), same as before.

Rest (DEP0142, DEP0198, etc, unused-export/circular-import warns) — just noise, left alone.
